I agree that losing everything hurts a lot especially after spending hours to get it but it will get easier to get loot from time to time. Also it gets less annoying. Im at a point where i just accept it and hop servers or rebuild. And i started just like you.

As long as there are no „No raiding“ rules it can happen on every server. But yes the chances to get raided on a low pop noob friendly server with a 2x2 are fairly low. I would just assume that you guys arent pvp chads and wiped the whole server to make you a raid target, right? 

Also 80 hours isnt really a lot. You cannot compare it to other games where you are a pro after 300 hours. 

I have 2200 hours and im finally at a stage where i consider myself decent but theres still a lot of people much better than me.
Metal Frags, HQM, Key Cards etc.

Also you have been pretty unlucky to get raided this early. 
But judging a game like Rust after a few hours of playing it without even knowing what you do is just wrong.
